coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web coverage: 20 captured search invocations and 552 aligned result headers, including four January date windows, generic English/Bangla protest terms, targeted SUST/Qawwali/labor/road-safety searches, national and regional outlet queries, and Dhaka, Sylhet and Barishal leads. Twelve source cards have recorded body scopes; 18 remain search-only, one exact URL was blocked by HTTP 403, and three UGC PDFs returned 404. The record includes separate SUST physical-action candidates, four Qawwali-related actions, one garment-worker demonstration and one search-only road-safety lead, plus one private-employer exclusion. Candidate eligibility, turnout, policy target and physical boundaries remain open where noted. Coverage does not reproduce LexisNexis and is not exhaustive; official baseline approval remains pending.
